notes.title: Atomic week & version 1.163
notes.notes:
Atomic week incoming!  

Believe it or not, 60 Seconds! has been out for nearly a year now. Only two days remain to our official anniversary day! This has been an amazing several months, but we will tell you more about it and what comes next on the 25th of May. 

Today, we want to kickstart the anniversary week with two awesome things:

SALE SALE SALE - for the entire week 60 Seconds! will be 50% off to celebrate the anniversary! Tell your friends!

PATCH PATCH PATCH  - today's update brings some promised fixes and a few things quite a few folks have been waiting for! Some highlights:

KEY REMAPPING 
We know a lot of people have been anxious to be able to remap their controls, especially for AZERTY keyboards. It is finally possible!

LIBERATION TIME! 
We've rebalanced the kidnappings and they will happen more frequently, along with chances to get back at those pesky bandits and to earn the Liberation achievement.

ARGH! CRASHES! 
We've had some reports of scavenge to survival transition crashes - these should be gone now. If you still experience that, please let us know. The same applies to Mac OSX startup crashes.

TYPOS & OTHER BOOK FIXES 
Many thanks to our great community for reporting issues with the texts - we're doing our best to keep up and resolve any text problems you find, so keep these reports coming!

Remember, if you run into any trouble with 60 Seconds! please report it on the Steam forums or drop us an e-mail at support@robotgentleman.com.

See you in two days!

23/05/2016 1.163 Anniversary week patch 

- Remapping keyboard and mouse control layout
- Apocalypse mode scavenge to survival transition crashes fixed
- rebalanced counter attack and invasion events to make kidnappings more common and in consequence the chances to earn the much desired Liberation achievement

PATCH PATCH PATCH  - today's update brings some promised fixes and a few things quite a few folks have been waiting for! Some highlights:

LIBERATION TIME!

ARGH! CRASHES!

TYPOS & OTHER BOOK FIXES 
Many thanks to our great community for reporting issues with the texts - we're doing our best to keep up and resolve any text problems you find, so keep these reports coming!

Remember, if you run into any trouble with 60 Seconds! please report it on the Steam forums or drop us an e-mail at support@robotgentleman.com.

See you in two days!

notes.title: To infinity and beyond! - version 1.160 & future plans
notes.notes:
Knock, knock survivors!

Patch time! As promised, we were able to address the new crashes reported after our last megaupdate, as well as the infinite loading screens. A few other problems were fixed too. If you encounter any issues please report them to us on the forums (preferably in the Bugs thread) or contact us directly at support@robotgentleman.com.

And now for something completely different...

We also wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a few things about our plans for 60 Seconds!. 

More frequent updates
It took us a while to deliver you the last update of 60 Seconds!. This was not something we intended, but unfortunately a few lines of development we were pursuing (Mac OSX fixes, additional language support, engine overhaul and optimisations) had to be integrated together in the end and we could not release them separately, as planned. Believe us when we say it was us frustrating to us, as it was to you.

Since that is the case, we are very happy to give you the good news - this is not going to happen again! We are back to our more frequent update cycle, where we will be addressing any issues reported relatively quickly. And every couple of updates we will be bringing you something bigger. What exactly? See below!

Linux/SteamOS support
Ever since we announced 60 Seconds! for Steam we wanted to bring it to Linux and SteamOS players to enjoy. And guess what? It is close! In fact, if you already own 60 Seconds! and also use Steam on a Linux machine, you can opt in to a beta branch of 60 Seconds!, which already has a working Linux build. We will be running some more tests to make sure it works well and hopefully publically release it in a little while!

Steam workshop support - modding!
We've been receiving questions about this for a while and we have actually hinted it on the forums once or twice. But now we can officially answer - are you going to release modding support for 60 Seconds!? Yes. Yes, we are.
We are already working on this and when the time comes, we will let you know about the exact features and ETA of 60 Seconds! mods.

New DLC!
We've said it plenty of times, but to put your mind at ease (in case you have any doubts!) - yes, we are working on another DLC for 60 Seconds!. Yes, it will be free for anyone who owns the game. And yes, it will contain plenty of new content. There is no release date, yet - as soon as we pick it, we will let you know.

Native gamepad support & presets
We've already mentioned this as our future development goal and following up on some questions we've been receiving from AZERTY keyboard users - we will be bringing keyboard preset customization, as well as native gamepad support to the game. We will also be working with the Steam Controller to make 60 Seconds! compatible with it.

As you see, the next few months should be quite exciting for the community. If you have any questions about the future of 60 Seconds! feel free to ask us about it either on the forums or by dropping us an e-mail.

Till next time!

10/04/2016 1.160 Post-megaupdate patch 

- infinite loading screens fixed
- scavenge start & end crashes fixed
- gift event - removed a bug where you would get no outcome of your decision
- reunion events - removed a bug where people could get sick and die instantly after coming back
- book fixes
- experimental 21:9 support (please let us know if it works well!)
- beta Linux/SteamOS build (available on opt-in beta branch)

notes.title: Language & optimisation update - version 1.159
notes.notes:
Wasteland ho!

Ladies and Gentleman, Survivalists and Raiders, we are happy to finally bring you the long awaited language and optimisation update!

Without further ado - the major features of today's update!

- Seven new languages: French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (BR), Russian and Spanish!
- Mac OSX crashes and common issues fixed!
- Major engine update!
- Optimisations!
- Common gamma issue fixed!
- Event issues fixed!
- And quite a few more fixes, additions, updates and changes to make 60 Seconds! even better!

This update is a major overhaul of 60 Seconds! and should improve the performance of the game for everyone. Please note that the size of the game has increased to 2.5 GB.

So why did it take us so long to get this update out? We will answer this and other questions you might have in another post tomorrow. In the meantime, enjoy the improved 60 Seconds! and if you run into any problems, be sure to drop us a line at support@robotgentleman.com or report them to the bug thread on our Steam forums. We are inviting all native speakers playing the game in one of the newly released languages to provide us with feedback about their language version!

If you want to find out more about the contents of the patch, detailed notes are available below.

- Updated the engine running the game
- Added support for new languages: French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portugese (BR), Russian, Spanish
- Added support for Eastern language wrapping
- Fixed a number of typos in Polish and English versions (also the one found by PewDiePie!)
- Updated scavenge level selection mechanism
- Added baked lightmaps to scavenge levels
- Updated the book

- Updated menu GUI
- Updated credits display
- Added 4:3 assets for menu, survival, loading screens 
- Removed forced letterboxes
- Updated expedition inventory "empty" icons

- Updated tutorial progression
- Updated tutorial gman character
- Fixed traders and auto traders events issues
- Updated the circle fader with new shader and setup
- Updated room, character and item prefabs
- Removed dynamic image effects
- Updated chances of kidnapping and rescuing family members
- Fixed issues with Counterattack, Graffiti, reunions, visitors, robberies events
- Fixed issues with water and food allocations
- Fixed a missing ending text for army absence
- Updated the shelter pointer
- Fixed an issue with duck and cover
- Updated event selection mechanism
- Updated highlighting to work with new engine version

notes.title: Patch date & Silicon Valley Comic Con
notes.notes:
Greetings from San Francisco! We came over for the 30th Game Developers Conference, which ended today, but our stay in USA is far from over. The entire Robot Gentleman team is headed to San Jose tomorrow (19th of March) and will be roaming the floors of the Silicon Valley Comic Con! 

If you love 60 Seconds! and would like to get a cool gift from our team, find us and say ‘hi’! There are only so many gifts we can carry, so first come, first served. 

How to find us? Look for top hats! See you in San Jose!

https://scontent-sjc2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xft1/t31.0-8/12593521_915322805241956_3544249431906100401_o.jpg

And now for the patch news...

We can finally announce that the language and optimisation patch, we've been talking about for a while, will be released on the 31st of March. It will include the support for seven new languages, a lot of optimisations to make the game run better and fixes for all the issues reported by Mac users, as well as a huge amount of other updates, bug fixes and improvements.

We will be publishing a detailed list of all the changes on the 31st along with some extra information regarding our future plans for 60 Seconds!.

If you have any questions to us, please post them on the forum. Remember that we also welcome any feedback and suggestions for improving the game and we really appreciate the support of our community!

Over and out!

notes.title: What's in the suitcase?! version 1.1
notes.notes:
Is it a bird? Is it a plane? NO! It's a suitcase!

http://www.robotgentleman.com/60seconds/assets/img/media/dlc1_tease.png

This is the moment everybody's been waiting for. 
THE SUITCASE HAS LANDED.

The first DLC to 60 Seconds! is now available for anyone who already owns the game and to anyone who will own it in the future! How great is that? Like 10 cans of soup worth of great!

What's in the suitcase?! is a content expansion that expands the game's content in many different ways. What ways you might ask? Well, let's see...

- a completely new happy ending - no more waiting for those damn GIs! 

- 60 new survival events and encounters! 

- 2 new useful items that you will surely grab before the First Aid Kit or even the Scout Handbook: the SUITCASE and the PADLOCK!

- new inventory gameplay mechanics for expeditions

- 12 new expeditions that will take your survivors to find paradises of supplies or to meet their grisly doom! 

- 12 new achievements that will test your survival skills to the limits! 

-  50 pages of new texts, including more status texts and completely new texts for events, expeditions and other aspects of the game. 

- technical upgrades to the game (new engine version!) and changes to the game's balance to make your stay in the fallout shelter more comfortable. Or painful. 

- new sound effects, new visuals, new ending graphics and new music tracks, including two new survival themes and six ending jingles!

If you will encounter any problems after the update releases, be sure to visit our bugs & issues topic on Steam forums http://steamcommunity.com/app/368360/discussions/0/613958868364858995/

If you can't find a resolution to your problem there, please do not hesitate to get in touch with us at support@robotgentleman.com.

See you somewhere in the wasteland!

- What's in the suitcase?! DLC release
- new happy ending
- 60 new events
- 12 new expeditions
- 2 new items
- inventory expedition gameplay
- 12 new achievements
- 50 pages of new texts
- engine tech upgrade
- new sfx, music and visuals
- Bugfixes & spelling corrections

If you will encounter any problems after the update releases, be sure to visit our bugs & issues topic on Steam forums http://steamcommunity.com/app/368360/discussions/0/613958868364858995/

If you can't find a resolution to your problem there, please do not hesitate to get in touch with us at support@robotgentleman.com.

See you somewhere in the wasteland!

Today's update: 12/09/2015 - 1.1

- What's in the suitcase?! DLC release
- new happy ending
- 60 new events
- 12 new expeditions
- 2 new items
- inventory expedition gameplay
- 12 new achievements
- 50 pages of new texts
- engine tech upgrade
- new sfx, music and visuals

notes.title: Duck and cover! version 1.042
notes.notes:
Hello all you atomic scavengers!

It took us a bit longer to deliver another update, due to some additional fixes we wanted to include in it, but you can expect the patch to land on Steam tomorrow at 1.00 PM CET.

We're announcing it ahead of time, because some changes in the game will result in BREAKING OLD SAVE FILES. So, if you have any unfinished survival games, please finish them before 1.00 PM CET on Saturday the 12th of June.

Remember that if you have any issues with the game, you can get in touch with us at support@robotgentleman.com to request help. We will do what we can to assist you.

Also, we will be announcing the first content update shortly. As mentioned before, all DLCs will be free, so you can expect more post-apocalyptic joy, without paying anything extra.

The wasteland awaits!

Tomorrow's update: 13/06/2015 - 1.042 

- Spelling corrections 
- Controls: stopped enforcing gamepad control when any gamepads connected
- Achievements: Enola Gay, Manhattan Project and Dead Hand fixed - if you were supposed to get them before, play and win one more game of any type on the chosen difficulty
- Achievements: 2-1-6 and Souper! now progress and show up properly in-game
- Scavenge: optimisation fixes - quality settings balancing, more aggressive occlusion, optimising assets
- Scavenge: fixed Ted's appearance on the fallout shelter screen of Scavenge game mode
- Scavenge: moved the collectable water bottle near one of the shelter variations
- Survival: changed save file format and introduced save file validation
- Survival: balancing event recurrence
- Survival: expedition event limits enforced
- Survival: added dehydration and starvation stages for thirst and hunger respectively
- Survival: reporting -1 for damaged items
- Survival: changed event report ordering for the last day of a survival game
- Survival: yes/no decision arrow showing bug fixed
- Survival: mutation chance decreased
- Survival: mutant stays in shelter graphical bug fixed
- Survival: mutant no longer takes gas masks for expeditions
- Survival: fix events only take place if you have the necessary item
- Survival: axe healing event bugs fixed
- Survival: sickness frequency balanced
- Survival: timberman event frequency increased
- Survival: fallout report text fixed
- Survival: reunion event frequency increased (again)
- Survival: treasure map and other custom expedition events updated
- Survival: invader events updated
- Survival: new cockroach event texts
- Survival: new attack event texts
- Survival: new army event texts
- Survival: new mood status texts

Update 13/06/2015 #2

And we're finally live with the update! Have fun!

Some changes and content additions resulted in an increased size of the game. Since that is the case we have updated the game's requirements accordingly and also made minimal requirements more precise.

Update 13/06/2015 #1

We're running some extra tests and the update will be deployed slightly later than we planned for. Not to worry - we're talking an extra hour or two. We will let you know, once the patch is live.

notes.title: Survival continues! version 1.034
notes.notes:
Greetings to you all, fallout shelter dwellers!

Thank you for all your comments and suggestions - as you can see in the update notes, we've started moving forward with content fixes and updates. If you have any problems, remember to take a peek at our bugs & issues thread http://steamcommunity.com/app/368360/discussions/0/613958868364858995/. 

If you can't find a resolution to your problem there, please do not hesitate to get in touch with us at support@robotgentleman.com.

A lot of people have been asking us about the version for Mac OS - we can confirm it is coming! We already have working builds, but we still need a little more time to test them. We're hopeful that either that one of the next two updates will bring the post-apocalyptic joy to Mac players!

Stay tuned for more!

Today's update: 04/06/2015 - 1.034 

- Spelling corrections
- Achievements: fixed "Tora! Tora! Tora!" achievement progression
- Tutorial: texts stay on screen a bit longer
- Tutorial: tutorial can and bottle moved
- Scavenge: limited full inventory notifications 
- Survival: save file corrupting bugs, related to dog and plant events, fixed (if you have any corrupted saves, they are unfortunately non-recoverable)
- Survival: Geiger counter sound now only plays until fallout is gone 
- Survival: fixed problems with a few event sounds not playing
- Survival: hunger is reported sooner
- Survival: problems with mutant "staying" in the shelter, after it runs away and mutant protecting the shelter, even though it's away, fixed
- Survival: reunion events chance increased
- Survival: food argument event effects corrected
- Survival: adjusted how tired people are after expeditions
- Survival: insanity very likely when only one person left
- Survival: forking of army rescue storyline fixed

notes.title: And so the first weekend begins...: version 1.033
notes.notes:
Hello all you post-apocalypse survivors!

Thank you for playing 60 Seconds! and sharing your thoughts about the game with us. We want to keep improving it, so every single of your suggestions matters to us.

We are currently focused on resolving technical issues, but we're slowly beginning to move towards content fixes. You can expect the next update to arrive quite soon.

Until then - good luck! You're going to need it in that fallout shelter.

Today's update: 30/05/2015 - 1.033

- fixed screen resolution adjustment problem for 5:4 and 4:3 resolutions (offset cursor problem)
- keyboard rotation sensitivity improved
- greater sensitivity for all controllers allowed
- text spelling corrections
- mutant no longer protects the shelter from attacks, when absent
- credit roll can now be skipped

notes.title: 60 Seconds! Day 2: version 1.032
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

we're truly overwhelmed with the positive response to the game and amount of great feedback all of you are providing us. We are doing our best to read your discussions on the community hub and e-mails that you send us.

We are also aware of several issues some of you have been having with running the game and we're trying to resolve them as soon as we can. If you encounter ANY problem that is preventing you from playing 60 Seconds! do not hesitate to mail us at support@robotgentleman.com or ping us on Twitter at @robotgentleman.

But let's get to the bottom of this, shall we? Yesterday we released version 1.032, which should have resolved a major issue with 32 bit OSes not supporting the game.

We also introduced Steam trading cards earlier yesterday. So what are you waiting for? Go get those badges!
